chunks: By the will of God they defeated them, and David killed Goliath, and God gave him kingship and wisdom, and taught him whatsoever He pleased. If God did not make men deter one another this earth would indeed be depraved. But gracious is God to the people of the world.

key_terms.دَفْعُ اللَّهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَع: God driving some people against others

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'daff al-ba't bi al-ba't' in the Quran?
ai.summary: This passage, often cited in Shia exegesis (tafsir) to validate the political authority (imamah) of the Prophet David, emphasizes that his kingship was not merely temporal but accompanied by divine wisdom and specific knowledge. The concept of 'daff al-ba'd bi al-ba'd' is interpreted by scholars as the mechanism of divine providence maintaining cosmic order through the interplay of human forces, preventing total societal collapse. This reinforces the Shia view that true leadership is a divine gift integrating spiritual insight with practical governance.
